caption: Starting peanuts for baby? 🥜👶 Here’s how we did it 🤍 I froze small portions of 100% peanut butter (no added sugar or salt) with milk-soaked bread to make it easier (and tastier!) to introduce ✨ Mixing with your baby’s milk makes it more familiar for your baby 👶 Every baby is different, so go at your own pace 🤍 ⸻ Always introduce allergens carefully and make sure your baby is ready 🤍 #startingsolids #babyfoodideas #introducingallergens #babyledweaning #momlifehacks
